annotations.title: imagepeek: make thumbnails of an image

description: imagepeek: Make 1-8 thumbnails of an image in one call. For one exact resize use image_resize. Returns 1-8 thumbnails in one call, each `sizes` entry {width, height} (at most 4096), by `fit` cover (smart centre crop with `gravity`, default) or contain; not upscaled unless `upscale`. The 15 MB output cap covers all of them together. The images come back in `images`. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-thumbnail-api.html

fit.description: cover (default: fill each size, cropping the overflow) or contain (fit inside, no crop).

format.description: Output format (default: the input's; ICO in, PNG out).

gravity.description: cover: the part to keep (default center; north, southeast, ...).

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.

upscale.description: Allow thumbnails larger than the input.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.

name: image_thumbnail

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
